column1: # xbios-bconmap-r1.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, the Bconmap table behind Bconmap(-2)
# (TASK/XBIOS05, user decision 2026-10-28): the BCONMAP and, through its maptab,
# pointer".  The !layout lines are copies of the tosdump-layout block in
# docs/api/structures/bconmap.md -- layoutcheck refuses this table if one
# differs.  m68k: BCONMAP 8 bytes + MAPTAB 24; LP64 16 + 48.
# A separate table, so bios-r1.tsv, xbios-chardev-r1.tsv and xbios-ptr-r1.tsv
# and their references stay as they are.  One table per round: the case id
# is the physical line number and the dump header carries the CRC of this
# file, so it is frozen once measured.

column5: Bconmap(-2) BCONMAP {maptab, maptabsize, mapped_device} and MAPTAB[0] -- bios/serport.c:962-968
